title: Interval
tagline: A clear view of your Machines.
summary: Paired open frames and warm ink surfaces turn a two-Machine Dashboard into a compact, readable register. Muted lilac belongs to navigation and identity; connection state and Verdict each get their own words. Empty space in the mark repeats in honest chart Gaps. The four selectable dark themes keep the same mark, geometry, typography and hierarchy while swapping semantic color tokens. Kanagawa remains the documented default; this exploratory ink palette is an alternative art direction, not a fifth-theme requirement.
logoRationale: Two opposing open frames represent two independent views. Neither encloses the other, matching the direct phone-to-Agent shape. The offset openings leave a recognizable central interval without a heartbeat, shield or implied safety guarantee. The mark uses two continuous paths with a 2.5-unit stroke on a 24-unit grid.

typography.ui: Android system sans / Roboto; system-ui fallback in this board
typography.numbers: JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals in Compose, per design.md; ui-monospace in this self-contained board
typography.wordmark: Original vector-drawn lowercase monoline lettering; no font dependency

strengths: Two Machines fit in a single Dashboard view
Connection state never borrows a reassuring Verdict
Flat rows and restrained color keep values legible
tradeoffs: The abstract mark needs the wordmark during early adoption
The lilac accent will shift under the four documented theme palettes
Dense detail rows need reflow at larger Android font settings
Static HTML cannot validate native interactions or rendering
